title: Birth in Melbourne and the band tour of England and Germany
summary: Polites was born in Melbourne in July 1927 and has just finished nearly two years touring England and Germany with a band.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape

blocks.x: Ah, yes, I was born in Melbourne, Australia. Um, July 1927.
July. No date, just July. Ah, second July. Second July, I see. 1927. And, uh, you've come here, you've been on a tour, huh?
Yes. Um, we took a band to England. Uh, we had a contract for six months. And, uh, managed to get the extensions of it and, uh, quite a few months in Germany. So we lasted nearly two years. Ah.
